electionType: Paramus Borough Mayor, Council & Board of Education General Election
councilStructure: Borough Form under Title 40A. Voters directly elect a Mayor (4-year term) and 6 Borough Council members elected at-large for staggered 3-year terms (2 elected each year).

councilCandidates.name: Christopher DiPiazza
councilCandidates.experience: Serving as Mayor of Paramus; lifelong borough resident, small business owner, and former Council President; led balanced municipal budgets while defending the borough's commercial ratable edge and Blue Laws.
councilCandidates.tagline: Protecting Paramus residential neighborhoods, low property tax rates, and world-class retail.
keyPlatformPillars: Vigorously defending Paramus commercial ratables to keep the residential property tax rate among the lowest in Bergen County (1.748%).
Protecting Bergen County's traditional Sunday Blue Laws to guarantee residential tranquility and traffic relief for local families.
verifiedSources: Paramus Borough Official Mayor & Council Proceedings
Bergen County Clerk Certified General Election Canvass

councilCandidates.name: Ace Antonio
councilCandidates.experience: Paramus Borough Council President; active in community youth sports and municipal finance oversight; focuses on senior services, road resurfacing, and park improvements.
councilCandidates.tagline: Senior property tax relief, recreational facility upgrades, and fiscal responsibility.
keyPlatformPillars: Expanding borough road repaving schedules and storm drain clearing without increasing long-term debt.
Strengthening municipal recreation facilities, community pool amenities, and programs for Paramus seniors.
verifiedSources: Bergen County Clerk Certified Nominating Petitions

councilCandidates.name: Robert Kaiser
councilCandidates.experience: Incumbent Borough Councilman; veteran public safety advocate and liaison to the Paramus Police Department and Volunteer Fire Department; focuses on neighborhood traffic safety.
councilCandidates.tagline: Backing local law enforcement, pedestrian traffic safety, and strict zoning enforcement.
keyPlatformPillars: Equipping the Paramus Police Department with modern traffic safety technology to curb cut-through commuter speeding.
Strict zoning code enforcement to preserve single-family residential neighborhoods against overdevelopment.

councilCandidates.name: Jeanne Weber
councilCandidates.experience: Longstanding Paramus Borough Councilwoman; respected community volunteer and environmental commissioner; champion of Saddle River flood control and tree canopy preservation.
councilCandidates.tagline: Flood mitigation, environmental green space preservation, and open government.
keyPlatformPillars: Partnering with Bergen County and NJ DEP on regional Saddle River desnagging and flood control projects.
Ensuring complete transparency in borough contract awards and municipal board appointments.
verifiedSources: Bergen County Clerk Certified Sample Ballots

boeCandidates.name: William F. Holzmann
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Distinguished Paramus Board of Education Trustee and past President; certified public accountant with extensive experience guiding district budgets.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Preserving educational excellence, expanding STEM and culinary arts, and fiscal accountability.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Maintaining high per-pupil classroom investments while adhering strictly to the 2% tax levy cap.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Completing high school HVAC installations, modernizing chemistry labs, and campus security vestibules.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Paramus schools set the gold standard in Bergen County. Our board ensures every taxpayer dollar is maximized for our students' future.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Academic rigor, special education funding, and long-term capital maintenance.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Transparent school budget forums and state grant acquisition.

boeCandidates.name: Joanne Bergmann
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Veteran School Board Trustee and past President; dedicated community volunteer and PTA leader focused on teacher retention and student wellness.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Student mental wellness, teacher recruitment, and early childhood literacy programs.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Auditing operational costs to prioritize direct teacher classroom compensation and technology.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Safe elementary school drop-off traffic loops and upgrading athletic track and field amenities.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: A strong school district builds a strong community. We are dedicated to providing our children with every opportunity to thrive.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Early literacy, teacher professional development, and student counseling.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Sustainable facility planning and community school use.

boeCandidates.name: Keri L. Greene
boeCandidates.term: Vote for up to 3 • 3-Year Full Term (2027–2029)
boeCandidates.experience: Incumbent Board of Education Trustee; parent advocate and active participant on curriculum and policy committees.
boeCandidates.keyFocus: Special education inclusion, career readiness, and open parent communication.
boeCandidates.fiscalStance: Ensuring transparent bidding on all district transportation and maintenance contracts.
boeCandidates.infrastructureStance: Modernizing digital library media centers and expanding high school athletic turf safety.

interviewStances.keyInterviewQuote: Every child learns differently. We must empower our educators with the resources needed to reach every individual student.
interviewStances.keyPriorities: Special needs inclusion, parent engagement, and fiscal discipline.
interviewStances.facilitiesAndBudget: Facility modernizations with zero taxpayer debt referendums.
